lines.text: This book satiated my craving for raunchy and wheeling historical fiction. Based on a real story, apprentice Gerta recounts her decades-long relationship with Maria Oosterwyck, an up-and-coming painter in 1600s Amsterdam. I was caught up in the nuance and passion with which Redel writes; you’ll also find yourself hanging onto every page as both women lust after each other, in admiration and envy. Fiction
